body.name: Diagonal lawful comparison-window schedule
body.construction:
For \(B_k=\{u:\|u\|_2\le k\}\), let \(d_n(B_k)\) be the centered local-expansion error, let \(\delta_n(B_k)=\max_j\sup_{u\in B_k}|e_{n,j}(u)|\), let \(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{Car},n}=C_{2/\kappa}|\mathcal J|\log|\mathcal J|/\sqrt n\), and let \(\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(B_k)\) be the explicit Gaussian Hellinger bound used in \(\text{thm:fixed-stratum-transfer}\). Choose rational \(\tau_k\downarrow0\) with \(\mathfrak b_0(2\tau_k)\le1/(2k)\), and let \(\mathscr E_n(k)\) be the sum of these terms, the finite-arrangement error from \(\text{lem:finite-completed-arrangement-stability}\), and \(\|c_n\|_\infty\). Define
\[
 R_n^{\diamond}=\max\left(\{0\}\cup\left\{1\le k\le n:
 B_k\subseteq\mathcal U_n,\ \min_{u\in B_k,j}p_{n,j}(u)\ge\kappa/2,
 \ \mathscr E_n(\ell)\le1/\ell\ \text{for every }1\le\ell\le k\right\}\right).
\]
This is the diagonal comparison window determined by the displayed expansion, covariance, Carter, offset, and finite-arrangement moduli.
inputs: the compact expansion and covariance moduli
